input: Mandatory acceptance run. Follow every step and do not skip any. 1. Write input.txt with the line acceptance input, then READ IT BACK with workspace_read. 2. Fetch https://example.com with web_fetch and note its title. 3. Run the calculation 17 * 23 with workspace_run. 4. MANDATORY: call delegate_research exactly once for the travel approval threshold under 500 USD in the company documents. Do not use search_documents or read_passages for this step. 5. Send an email to anthony@officeinference.com with subject Acceptance run and a body containing the calculation, the page title and the threshold. This send needs approval. 6. Write acceptance.txt with those results. The final answer MUST include numbered citations [1] for https://example.com and [2] for the policy, or it fails verification.
